entries.title: Governance-Only Closure Until Live Sections Are Satisfied
entries.summary: Freeze non-governance program work until live governance sections, routing rules, and authority layers are explicitly satisfied.
completion_criteria: All active governance blocker tasks are resolved or explicitly demoted by governance authority.
Live governance routing is complete enough to support deterministic agent execution.
The execution gate is explicitly lifted in the live Program Task Registry.
entries.notes: Resolved on 2026-07-02 after the ordered governance debt list was fully discharged, live routing surfaces were normalized, and the governance-only closure condition was satisfied.

entries.title: Require Registry and Queue for All New Inductions
entries.summary: Establish a governed induction intake system in which every new induction must be both canonically registered and live-queued before use.
completion_criteria: Every new induction has both a registry entry and a queue entry.
Lexicon gap routing is linked from induction intake.
Ungoverned inductions are blocked from downstream program use.
entries.notes: Resolved on 2026-07-01 after creating the live induction queue, canonical induction registry, textbook routing rule, and backfilling active inductions into both surfaces.

entries.title: Execute Governance Debt Discharge Command in Declared Order
entries.summary: Reduce governance debt in the explicit live-command order and report each discharge step under governed validation.
completion_criteria: Debts listed in governance/live/debt_discharge_command.json are reduced in the declared order or explicitly justified if blocked.
Each discharge step produces a governed report aligned to the required report structure.
The active governance-first execution gate can be reevaluated after the ordered list is complete.
entries.notes: Resolved on 2026-07-02 after all debts listed in governance/live/debt_discharge_command.json were discharged in order with governed validation.

entries.title: Normalize Department Peer Directory Layout
entries.summary: Ensure all departments exist as peers under departments/ without structurally privileging any department.
deliverables: Peer directory records for all inducted and planned departments
completion_criteria: All active and planned departments have peer directory records.
Department Registry reflects directory paths.
No department is treated as structurally global by folder location.
entries.notes: Resolved on 2026-07-02 by creating placeholder peer roots for mathematics, economics, and theology, and by recording the peer-root versus induction boundary in the live department layout manifest.

entries.title: Normalize Physics Department SSOT Naming
entries.summary: Normalize the Physics Department local SSOT filename to the common department_ssot.md convention or explicitly ratify the exception.
deliverables: Normalized local SSOT filename or explicit exception record
completion_criteria: departments/physics/department_ssot.md exists or an explicit naming exception is recorded.
Physics scope and prohibited promotions remain declared.
Physics dependence on mathematics remains declared.
entries.notes: Resolved on 2026-07-02 by renaming the local physics SSOT to departments/physics/department_ssot.md and updating live routing references.

entries.title: Separate Mathematics and Physics Claim Routing
entries.summary: Prevent formal mathematical derivations from being treated as physical claims and prevent physical interpretations from being treated as mathematical theorems.
completion_criteria: Mathematics allowed claims are declared.
Physics allowed claims are declared.
Correspondence rule requirement is declared.
Vector routing policy distinguishes math from physics.
entries.notes: Resolved on 2026-07-02 by translating the existing cleanup patch into a live math/physics boundary manifest, binding the routing and claim-class rules into the authority layer, and aligning the textbook and physics SSOT with the same boundary.

entries.title: Execute Non-Governance Program Debt Discharge Command in Declared Order
entries.summary: Reduce remaining non-governance program debt in one explicit live-command order and report each discharge step under governed validation.
completion_criteria: Debts listed in governance/live/program_debt_discharge_command.json are reduced in the declared order or explicitly justified if blocked.
Each discharge step produces a governed report aligned to the required report structure.
The remaining non-governance debt lane becomes explicitly auditable.
entries.notes: Resolved on 2026-07-02 after the ordered non-governance debt list was fully discharged in sequence and the final operator-genealogy debt was closed under governed validation.

entries.title: Transition Governance from Proposal Specs to Live Ledgers
entries.summary: Separate governance specifications from live canonical ledgers and require operational consumers to read live ledgers only.
completion_criteria: Operational governance artifacts are distinguishable from proposal specifications.
Live ledgers contain no proposal metadata.
Operational routing can resolve live ledgers deterministically.
entries.notes: Live-ledger separation and authority routing are now established in the operational governance layer.
